title: Quantitative Stability for Minimizing Yamabe Metrics with minimal boundary
summary: In this paper, we investigate the stability of minimizing Yamabe metrics on compact manifolds with boundary, in the sense introduced by Escobar. We show that if a function nearly minimizes the Yamabe energy, then the associated conformal metric is quantitatively close to a minimizing Yamabe metric within its conformal class. Moreover, this closeness is controlled by an appropriate power of the Yamabe energy deficit.
